title: Sotāpannasuttaṃ
text: 166 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca – ‘‘pañcime, rādha, upādānakkhandhā. Katame pañca? Rūpupādānakkhandho…pe… viññāṇupādānakkhandho. Yato kho, rādha, ariyasāvako imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti – ayaṃ vuccati, rādha, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano’’ti. Sattamaṃ.
